abstract: Looking at each measure, the groups differ in these ways. Overall, Cardivel improves systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Cardivel improves systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. All data for this comparison were collected at the Oakfield Family Cohort.

Table 1. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Systolic drop | 11.2 | 5.6 | 450 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 9.5 | 4.8 | 450 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 10.9 | 5.5 | 450 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Systolic drop | 11.2 | 5.6 | 450 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 15.2 | 7.6 | 450 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 11.0 | 5.5 | 450 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
